desc: Implement the initial 3D unique-parent best-first search solution with descending sort, truncation, packed keys, root-multiplicity shortcut, and axis ordering.
Fix the heap update bug by keeping `heappop` and using `heappush` for all children, then pass the three sample tests.
Confirm correctness and performance: monotone tree enumeration, truncation to `m = min(N, K)`, edge cases, and `O(N log N + K log K)` heap search satisfy the constraints.
